meta.method: Manual review of locally available title, news_type, topic evidence snippets, article.quote (when present), company-story metadata, and thesis links. Full article bodies are not stored in data/cards*, web/public/data/stories, or companies/*.json (body_len=0 everywhere checked); evidence vs body is therefore limited to quote↔title/topic consistency plus pipeline check flags.
meta.selection_rationale: Varied companies, news types (earnings, M&A/deal, takeover, plan/guidance, analyst rating, tape-recap), clear vs ambiguous name matches, with and without thesis links (ENEL indicator link; LDO false-person match as negative control).

evidence.note: No local bodies; partial = quote/title/topic internally consistent and/or automated verbatim flags present, but not re-verified against full body.

articles.title: Garofalo Health Care, l’utile frena ma i ricavi aumentano. In cerca di nuove opportunità di crescita m&a
articles.notes: Correct single-company match. Primary earnings type fits results headline; secondary deal/plan topics echo M&A/investments in the title. Quote on net income −21.8% supports 'frena'; starts with typo 'll'. Body not local.

articles.title: NewPrinces raddoppia i ricavi e accelera sull’ebitda, ma chiude il semestre ancora in perdita
articles.notes: Clear name match. Earnings classification correct; capital topic on net debt is secondary. Quote on −5.8m net result supports 'in perdita'. Body not local.

articles.title: Gaming, Lottomatica (-11,2%) rileva Cirsa: nasce il secondo operatore globale quotato. Perché il titolo crolla
articles.notes: Acquirer correctly matched (not Cirsa). Deal primary is right; market_report/analyst secondary fit. Gemini article.quote is the −11.2% open, not the Cirsa terms — substantive deal evidence only in topics[]. Body not local.

articles.title: Pininfarina verso il delisting da Piazza Affari: opa a 1 euro, premio del 20%
articles.notes: Correct match and takeover type. Quote on 20% premium aligns with title; capital/governance topics coherent. Body not local.

articles.title: Maire, nuovi ordini per 110 milioni: la controllata Tecnimont si rafforza nel gas in Sud America e in Asia
articles.notes: Company match correct. Classified as deal, but content is new orders/contracts (commercial backlog), not M&A. Taxonomy stretch. Quote '110 milioni' matches title. Body not local.

articles.title: Iren, dividendo al 6,7% nel 2027: il piano di ottobre può spingere il titolo. L’analisi di Equita
articles.notes: Match correct. Gemini/choose_news → plan; company export still capital; title mixes dividend, industrial plan, and Equita note — plan is defensible but pipelines disagree. Body not local.

articles.title: Rai Way, Morgan Stanley taglia il target price del 20%: 5 motivi per cui resta cauta sul titolo
articles.notes: Clear match. Analyst primary correct; plan/earnings secondary from broker note. Quote on TP 6.7→5.4 (−20%) matches title. Body not local.

articles.title: Nexi: il titolo prova un nuovo allungo
articles.notes: Tape-recap / technical note correctly typed market_report. Quote is chart language (4.10–4.40). Body not local.

articles.title: Moncler: il trend rimane negativo
articles.notes: Match correct. Gemini market_report fits tape-recap; company story still 'other' — export inconsistency, not a wrong read of the title. Body not local.

articles.title: Essilux, Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio sbarca su X e attacca Milleri sui compensi
articles.notes: False positive: person name 'Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio' matched to Leonardo SpA (FINME). Story is about EssilorLuxottica/Delfin family governance, not the defence contractor. No Gemini card. Pattern is large: ~80/749 Leonardo company stories mention Del Vecchio / Leonardo Maria (~11%). LDO thesis debug also lists a Del Vecchio Delfin piece among 2T26 earnings candidates.

articles.title: Enel, la controllata Usa torna a fare cassa e avvia una nuova fase di m&a nelle rinnovabili
articles.thesis_indicator: Free cash flow dopo gli investimenti
articles.notes: Company match and deal type OK for US sub cash + renewables M&A. Thesis link to FCF-after-investments is plausible from 'fare cassa' but loose without body evidence that FCF/capex is discussed. No quote on card. Body not local.

articles.title: Webuild smentisce la richiesta di 22 miliardi al governo: il titolo chiude in calo del 7,9%
articles.notes: Match correct. Keyword wanted capital; choose_news correctly rejects capital evidence (denial ≠ capital raise) and picks market_report because of the −7.9% tape line. Primary story is a denial/clarification; market_report is imperfect but better than capital. Quote is only the close. Body not local.

error_patterns.severity: Title regex on DES_AZIONE matches person/football names sharing a listed company string (esp. Leonardo ↔ Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio).
keyword_news_type / company-story news_type / Gemini choose_news news_type disagree (Iren capital vs plan; Webuild capital vs market_report; Moncler other vs market_report).
Commercial orders/contracts labelled deal (Maire 110m), conflating backlog news with M&A.
Thesis–news mapping can attach a story to an indicator from headline alone (Enel M&A/cash → FCF indicator) without quote-level support in the shipped card.
On mixed deal+tape headlines, article.quote often stores the price move, while deal facts live only in topics[].evidence.
Exported cards/stories omit body text, so offline audit cannot re-check citazione against source beyond build-time flags.

recommended_fixes: Add negative match rules for known homonyms (e.g. 'Leonardo Maria', 'Del Vecchio', Figc football contexts) before accepting DES_AZIONE hits; optionally require defence/aerospace context for FINME.
Export a single canonical news_type (post choose_news) into company stories so UI/stats and Gemini cards do not diverge.
Introduce or map an orders/contract topic distinct from M&A deal, or bias choose_news away from deal when only 'ordini/commesse' evidence is present.
Require thesis-indicator assignment to cite a verbatim span that mentions the indicator concept; mark links without quote as low confidence.
When both substance and tape topics exist, prefer a substantive quote for article.quote (keep tape in topics).
Optionally ship a short body excerpt or hash in public cards to allow offline quote re-verification.
